tools.description: Find stock in this workspace by product name, or by a barcode when the text is one. Returns stock on hand grouped into rows a picker can choose from; interchangeable records (same product, shelf and no date or serial) are one row with the total. When nothing is on hand, returns catalogue records matching the text, so a product with no stock is still found. Use get_item for one record; use list_locations first when you need a shelf id. Example: search_items(query="olive oil").

tools.description: List the shelves, zones and other locations of this workspace, flat, in name order, with each location parent_id. Use it to find a shelf id for search_items, get_stock_levels or get_expiring_soon, or to see the whole hierarchy as a flat page. Use get_location_tree for the hierarchy nested. Filter with usage when you only want internal stock, for example. Example: list_locations(usage="internal").

tools.description: Read locations as a tree: roots with their children. Without root_id it is the whole workspace hierarchy; with root_id it is that location and everything below it, plus its ancestors as a breadcrumb. Use it when a person says "the cold room" or "aisle 3" and you need the shelves under it. Example: get_location_tree(root_id="<a zone id>").

tools.description: Read quantities per product, shelf and batch. Narrow by product template, or by shelf. A shelf with no product filter answers per-product totals for the whole shelf; otherwise every quant row is returned (one row per product/batch/owner). Use search_items when you are looking for a record to act on; use this when you need the numbers. Example: get_stock_levels(shelf_id="<id>").

tools.description: List stock expiring within N days (default 7), earliest first, with how many days are left. Example: get_expiring_soon(days=3).
